opening.argument: The speaker presents Forsage as an earning opportunity, claiming that “here people earn thousands of lakhs per day,” an unusually large earnings assertion that is not accompanied by a substantive explanation of the risks or how those returns are generated. The displayed webpage reinforces that presentation by identifying Forsage as a DeFi tool to earn money and prominently offering sign-in and registration options. The invitation to continue engagement through a WhatsApp group, where “I have given the link of my whatsapp group in the description,” further directs viewers toward the promoted opportunity. Taken together, these features present a money-making proposition and a path for follow-up without balanced discussion of the basis or risks of the claimed earnings.
